Fix a ring $R$, integers $m\geq0$ and $n\geq1$, and $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$. Set $X=\operatorname{Spec}R[x_1,\ldots,x_m,y_1,\ldots,y_n]=\mathbf A^{m+n}_S$, and let $i:Z=\mathbf A^m_S\hookrightarrow X$ be defined by $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$. Let $b:L=\operatorname{Bl}_Z(X)\to X$ be the blow-up, $P=Z\times_S\mathbf P^{n-1}_S$, and $p:P\to Z$ the projection. Identify the exceptional divisor $E\subset L$ with $P$ via its zero-section embedding into the natural line bundle $L\to P$.

For every $a\geq0$:
(1) the natural map $\Omega^a_{X/S}\xrightarrow{\sim}b_*\Omega^a_{L/S}$ is an isomorphism;
(2) the natural map $\Omega^a_{Z/S}\xrightarrow{\sim}p_*\Omega^a_{P/S}$ is an isomorphism; and
(3) the map $Rb_*\Omega^a_{L/S}\to i_*Rp_*\Omega^a_{P/S}$ induces an isomorphism on cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^j$ for every $j\geq1$.
hypotheses: $L$ is the blow-up of the specified affine space $X=\mathbf A^{m+n}_S$ along its standard coordinate subspace $Z=\mathbf A^m_S$, with $n\geq1$.
conclusions: The two degree-zero direct-image comparisons and the positive-degree derived direct-image comparison for relative differential forms are isomorphisms.

\label{lemma-blowup-twist-same-cohomology}
Let $E = 0(P)$ be the exceptional divisor of the blowing up $b$.
For any locally free $\mathcal{O}_X$-module $\mathcal{E}$ and
$0 \leq i \leq n - 1$ the map
$$
\mathcal{E}
\longrightarrow
Rb_*(b^*\mathcal{E} \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_L} \mathcal{O}_L(iE))
$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal{O}_X)$.

Fix a ring $R$, integers $m\geq0$ and $n\geq1$, and $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$. Set $X=\operatorname{Spec}R[x_1,\ldots,x_m,y_1,\ldots,y_n]=\mathbf A^{m+n}_S$, and let $i:Z=\mathbf A^m_S\hookrightarrow X$ be defined by $(y_1,\ldots,y_n)$. Let $b:L=\operatorname{Bl}_Z(X)\to X$ be the blow-up, $P=Z\times_S\mathbf P^{n-1}_S$, and $p:P\to Z$ the projection. Identify the exceptional divisor $E\subset L$ with $P$ via its zero-section embedding into the natural line bundle $L\to P$.

If $\mathcal E$ is any locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module and $0\leq j\leq n-1$, the canonical map
$$\mathcal E\longrightarrow Rb_*\bigl(b^*\mathcal E\otimes_{\mathcal O_L}\mathcal O_L(jE)\bigr)$$
is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_X)$.
hypotheses: $b:L\to X$ is the above standard blow-up of codimension $n$ with exceptional divisor $E$; $\mathcal E$ is locally free and $0\leq j\leq n-1$.
conclusions: The twisted pullback of $\mathcal E$ has derived direct image canonically isomorphic to $\mathcal E$.
